name_en: Remove caries + indirect pulp cap with hydraulic calcium silicate cement (MTA/Biodentine); definitive restoration in same visit
name_cn: 去龋 + 间接盖髓 (MTA/Biodentine) + 同期最终修复
rationale_en: Reversible inflammation resolves once stimulus (caries) is removed. MTA/Biodentine preserves pulp vitality; Ca(OH)₂ is an alternative but not first-line.
rationale_cn: 去除刺激源（龋）后炎症可恢复。MTA/Biodentine保留牙髓活力；氢氧化钙为替代方案。

name_en: Follow-up vitality testing at 6 + 12 months
name_cn: 6/12月活力测试随访
rationale_en: Confirm pulp recovery; if vitality declines or pain returns, re-diagnose (likely K04.01).
rationale_cn: 确认牙髓恢复；若活力下降或疼痛复发，需重新诊断（可能为K04.01）。

name_en: Root canal treatment (full RCT) → composite core or post + crown within 3 months
name_cn: 完整根管治疗 → 3月内树脂核或桩冠修复
rationale_en: Definitive treatment for irreversible pulpitis preserving the natural tooth. Crown protects against fracture (REF-005, REF-008).
rationale_cn: 不可复性牙髓炎的根本治疗，保留天然牙。冠修复防止牙折。

name_en: Full or partial pulpotomy with MTA/Biodentine (vital pulp therapy, selected cases)
name_cn: 完全或部分冠髓切断 (MTA/Biodentine)
rationale_en: VPT can preserve vital tissue in selected irreversible pulpitis cases (young apex, controlled bleeding). EFCD-ESE-ORCA S3 2025 supports as alternative to RCT.
rationale_cn: 选择性病例（年轻根尖、止血可控）可保留活髓。EFCD-ESE-ORCA S3 2025支持作为RCT替代方案。

name_en: Pulpectomy with resorbable paste (primary tooth)
name_cn: 乳牙根管治疗 (可吸收糊剂)
rationale_en: Primary tooth with >2/3 root remaining: pulpectomy preserves space until natural exfoliation.
rationale_cn: 乳牙剩余牙根>2/3：根管治疗保留间隙至自然脱落。

name_en: Extraction + prosthetic planning
name_cn: 拔牙 + 修复方案
rationale_en: Non-restorable tooth: RCT is futile; extract and plan replacement.
rationale_cn: 不可修复牙：RCT无意义，拔除后规划修复。

name_en: Emergency pulpotomy (relief of pressure) → complete RCT at follow-up
name_cn: 急诊冠髓切断减压 → 复诊完成RCT
rationale_en: Immediate drainage relieves pain; full RCT completes treatment.
rationale_cn: 立即引流缓解疼痛；后续完成完整RCT。

name_en: Root canal treatment + crown
name_cn: 根管治疗 + 冠修复
rationale_en: Chronic pulpitis (incl. pulp polyp) is irreversible; RCT is definitive.
rationale_cn: 慢性牙髓炎（含牙髓息肉）不可复，RCT为根本治疗。

name_en: Root canal treatment → core + crown
name_cn: 根管治疗 → 核冠修复
rationale_en: Non-vital tooth without periapical changes: standard RCT.
rationale_cn: 无根尖病变的死髓牙：常规RCT。

name_en: Apexification (MTA/Biodentine apical plug) → orthograde obturation
name_cn: 根尖诱导成形术 (MTA/Biodentine根尖屏障) → 顺行充填
rationale_en: Necrotic immature permanent tooth: apexification creates an apical barrier before obturation.
rationale_cn: 未成熟恒牙坏死：根尖诱导成形术建立根尖屏障后再充填。

name_en: Occlusal adjustment (relieve traumatic occlusion) + initiate RCT (drainage if pulp necrotic)
name_cn: 调𬌗（解除咬合创伤）+ 启动RCT（牙髓坏死者引流）
rationale_en: Address the cause (pulpal disease) + relieve the symptomatic trigger (occlusal trauma).
rationale_cn: 处理病因（牙髓疾病）+ 解除症状诱因（咬合创伤）。

name_en: RCT (expected healing 6-12 months) + 6-month periapical X-ray review
name_cn: RCT（预期愈合6-12月）+ 6月根尖片复查
rationale_en: Primary endodontic treatment of an asymptomatic apical lesion; larger lesions heal more slowly.
rationale_cn: 无症状根尖病变的初次根管治疗；病变越大愈合越慢。

name_en: Endodontic re-treatment OR apicoectomy
name_cn: 根管再治疗 或 根尖手术
rationale_en: Persistent lesion after prior RCT: re-treat orthograde first; surgery if re-treatment fails or is not feasible.
rationale_cn: RCT后病变持续：优先顺行再治疗；再治疗失败或不可行时考虑根尖手术。

name_en: RCT (sinus typically resolves within weeks of obturation); no antibiotics needed if afebrile and no spread
name_cn: RCT（窦道通常在充填后数周内闭合）；无发热和扩散时不需抗生素
rationale_en: Sinus drainage means infection is contained; antibiotic stewardship — reserve for systemic involvement.
rationale_cn: 窦道引流提示感染局限；抗生素管理——仅用于全身受累者。

name_en: Emergency drainage (through tooth or incision) + RCT initiation; antibiotics if systemic signs (fever, malaise, lymphadenopathy) or spreading infection
name_cn: 急诊引流（经牙体或切开）+ 启动RCT；有全身症状（发热、不适、淋巴结肿大）或扩散感染时加抗生素
rationale_en: Drainage is the primary treatment; antibiotics are adjunctive only when systemic signs present.
rationale_cn: 引流为主要治疗；抗生素仅在出现全身症状时作为辅助。

name_en: Hospital referral for IV antibiotics + airway assessment
name_cn: 住院静脉抗生素 + 气道评估
gates: swelling_spread in [floor_of_mouth, submandibular, periorbital]|airway_compromise=yes OR trismus=severe OR fever>=38.5
rationale_en: Ludwig's angina / spreading odontogenic infection is life-threatening — hospital management.
rationale_cn: Ludwig咽峡炎/扩散性牙源性感染危及生命——需住院治疗。

name_en: Remineralisation therapy: 5% NaF varnish 2-4x/year + 1450ppm fluoride toothpaste + diet/biofilm counselling
name_cn: 再矿化治疗：5%氟化钠涂层每年2-4次 + 1450ppm含氟牙膏 + 饮食/菌斑指导
rationale_en: Non-cavitated active enamel lesions can be arrested or reversed by fluoride + biofilm control (ADA 2018 non-restorative guideline).
rationale_cn: 非洞型活动性釉质病变可通过氟化物+菌斑控制实现静止或逆转（ADA 2018非修复指南）。

name_en: Resin infiltration (anterior aesthetic white-spot lesions)
name_cn: 树脂渗透 (前牙美观白斑病变)
rationale_en: Resin infiltration arrests progression and improves aesthetics without drilling.
rationale_cn: 树脂渗透阻止进展并改善美观，无需备洞。

name_en: Selective caries removal + composite resin restoration
name_cn: 选择性去龋 + 复合树脂充填
rationale_en: Standard restorative for mid-dentinal caries with adequate dentine remaining. Selective removal preserves vital tissue (REF-007, EFCD-ESE-ORCA 2025).
rationale_cn: 中度牙本质龋且剩余牙本质充足时的标准修复。选择性去龋保留活髓组织。

name_en: Remove old restoration → reassess depth → composite (or escalate per new depth)
name_cn: 去除旧充填 → 重新评估深度 → 复合树脂充填（或按新深度升级）
rationale_en: True extent only visible after old material is removed; reassess before placing definitive restoration.
rationale_cn: 旧材料去除后才能见到真实范围；重新评估后再行最终修复。

name_en: Indirect pulp cap with hydraulic calcium silicate cement (MTA/Biodentine) → composite restoration; 3-month vitality review
name_cn: 间接盖髓 (MTA/Biodentine) → 复合树脂充填；3月活力复查
rationale_en: Deep caries with thin dentine but no irreversible signs: MTA/Biodentine liner preserves pulp; hard re-entry not required (EFCD-ESE-ORCA S3 2025).
rationale_cn: 深龋伴牙本质菲薄但无不可复性体征：MTA/Biodentine垫底保护牙髓；不需硬性二次入路（EFCD-ESE-ORCA S3 2025）。

name_en: Ceramic inlay / onlay (large proximal lesion in posterior teeth)
name_cn: 瓷嵌体 / 高嵌体 (后牙大面积邻面龋)
rationale_en: When lesion exceeds 2/3 intercuspal width: inlay/onlay offers better contact, occlusion, and longevity than direct composite.
rationale_cn: 龋损超过牙尖间宽2/3：嵌体/高嵌体在接触、咬合和耐久性上优于直接树脂。

name_en: GIC filling (primary tooth, asymptomatic or brief provoked pain)
name_cn: 玻璃离子充填 (乳牙，无症状或短暂激发痛)
rationale_en: GIC preferred for primary teeth: moisture tolerance, fluoride release, simpler technique.
rationale_cn: 乳牙首选GIC：耐湿、缓释氟、操作简便。

name_en: Hall Technique (preformed metal crown on primary molar without local anaesthesia or caries removal)
name_cn: Hall技术 (乳磨牙预成金属冠，无需麻醉与去龋)
rationale_en: Evidence-based option for primary molars in young or anxious patients: seals caries under SSC without drilling. RCTs show non-inferiority to conventional restoration over 5 years.
rationale_cn: 幼儿或焦虑患者的循证选项：不动钻在乳磨牙不锈钢冠下封闭龋损。5年RCT与传统修复相当。

name_en: Pulpotomy (primary tooth) — if selective caries removal exposes vital pulp
name_cn: 乳牙活髓切断术 — 选择性去龋时露髓
rationale_en: If caries removal exposes vital pulp in a primary tooth: pulpotomy with MTA/Biodentine; SSC restoration preferred (AAPD 2024).
rationale_cn: 乳牙去龋暴露活髓：MTA/Biodentine活髓切断；首选不锈钢冠修复（AAPD 2024）。

name_en: Extraction + prosthetic planning
name_cn: 拔牙 + 修复方案
rationale_en: Non-restorable tooth: restorative attempts futile.
rationale_cn: 不可修复：修复尝试无意义。

name_en: Monitor + maintain (no active treatment; reinforce fluoride/hygiene)
name_cn: 观察维护（不主动治疗；强化氟化物/口腔卫生）
rationale_en: Arrested lesions in hygiene-accessible areas do not require restoration; over-treatment risks pulp injury (ADA 2018).
rationale_cn: 卫生可及区域的静止龋无需修复；过度治疗有牙髓损伤风险（ADA 2018）。

name_en: Restore for aesthetics or function (composite or GIC, conservative cavity prep)
name_cn: 美观或功能修复 (复合树脂或GIC，保守备洞)
rationale_en: Restore only when a functional, aesthetic, or cleansability indication exists.
rationale_cn: 仅在功能、美观或清洁性问题存在时修复。

name_en: Fissure sealant (resin-based or GIC)
name_cn: 窝沟封闭 (树脂或玻璃离子)
rationale_en: Sealants arrest non-cavitated pit/fissure caries; evidence-based first-line (ADA 2016 sealants guideline, REF-027).
rationale_cn: 窝沟封闭可阻止非洞型窝沟龋；循证一线（ADA 2016 封闭指南）。

name_en: Topical 38% silver diamine fluoride (SDF) arrest treatment + monitoring
name_cn: 38%氟化银 (SDF) 涂布阻止治疗 + 复查
gates: patient_age=elderly OR patient_cooperative=limited|aesthetic_concern=no OR posterior_tooth=yes|cavitation_size in [small, medium]
rationale_en: SDF arrests root caries in elderly/cognitively-impaired patients without restoration. Black staining limits anterior aesthetic use (ADA 2018).
rationale_cn: SDF可在老年/认知障碍患者中阻止根面龋，无需修复。染黑限制前牙美观应用（ADA 2018）。

name_en: GIC restoration (root caries — preferred over composite for moisture tolerance + fluoride release)
name_cn: GIC修复 (根面龋——耐湿+释氟优于复合树脂)
rationale_en: Root surface isolation is difficult; GIC's moisture tolerance and fluoride release make it preferred for cervical/root restorations.
rationale_cn: 根面隔湿困难；GIC的耐湿和释氟使其成为颈部/根面修复首选。

name_en: Supragingival scaling + OHI (oral hygiene instruction) + 4–6 week reassessment
name_cn: 龈上洁治 + 口腔卫生指导 + 4–6周复查
rationale_en: Plaque-induced gingivitis is reversible — supragingival biofilm removal + sustained OHI resolves inflammation. Reassess at 4–6 weeks to confirm BOP reduction.
rationale_cn: 菌斑性龈炎可逆——龈上菌斑清除+持续口腔卫生指导可消除炎症。4–6周复查确认BOP减少。

name_en: Adjunctive chlorhexidine 0.12% mouthrinse (short-term, 2 weeks max)
name_cn: 辅助氯己定0.12%含漱液 (短期使用，最长2周)
rationale_en: Chlorhexidine is adjunctive, not a substitute for mechanical plaque control. Limit to 2 weeks (staining, taste alteration). Reserve for periods when mechanical cleaning is impaired.
rationale_cn: 氯己定为辅助手段，不可替代机械菌斑控制。限用2周（染色、味觉改变）。仅用于机械清洁受限时。

name_en: Specialist evaluation (oral medicine / periodontology) — identify underlying cause before symptomatic treatment
name_cn: 专科评估（口腔黏膜病/牙周病专科）——确定病因后再对症治疗
rationale_en: Non-plaque-induced gingivitis has diverse causes (viral, fungal, allergic, drug-induced, systemic disease). Standard plaque-control treatment will not resolve underlying cause — specialist evaluation is required.
rationale_cn: 非菌斑性龈炎病因多样（病毒、真菌、过敏、药物、全身疾病）。常规菌斑控制无法解决根本病因——需专科评估。

name_en: Drainage (through pocket or incision) + subgingival debridement + saline irrigation
name_cn: 引流（经牙周袋或切开）+ 龈下清创 + 盐水冲洗
rationale_en: Drainage is the definitive treatment for localised periodontal abscess. Antibiotic stewardship: do NOT prescribe antibiotics without systemic signs (REF-022, REF-023).
rationale_cn: 引流是局限性牙周脓肿的根本治疗。抗生素管理：无全身症状时不开抗生素（REF-022, REF-023）。

name_en: Drainage + adjunctive systemic antibiotics (amoxicillin 500mg TID 5–7d, or metronidazole 400mg TID if pen-allergic) — only with systemic signs
name_cn: 引流 + 辅助全身抗生素（阿莫西林500mg TID 5–7天，青霉素过敏者甲硝唑400mg TID）——仅在全身症状存在时
rationale_en: Systemic antibiotics are indicated when fever, lymphadenopathy, or spreading cellulitis present. Drainage remains the primary intervention.
rationale_cn: 全身症状（发热、淋巴结肿大、扩散性蜂窝织炎）时需用全身抗生素。引流仍为主要治疗。

name_en: Hospital referral for IV antibiotics + airway/spread assessment
name_cn: 住院静脉抗生素 + 气道/扩散评估
rationale_en: Spreading odontogenic infection from periodontal source — same emergency pathway as K04.7.
rationale_cn: 牙周源性扩散感染——与K04.7同样的急诊路径。

name_en: Extraction + drainage (tooth not restorable / hopeless)
name_cn: 拔牙 + 引流（牙体不可修复/无望）
rationale_en: Hopeless tooth + periodontal abscess: extraction simultaneously achieves drainage and removes the source.
rationale_cn: 无望牙伴牙周脓肿：拔牙同时实现引流并去除病源。

name_en: Scaling and root planing (SRP) per quadrant + OHI + 6–8 week reassessment
name_cn: 龈下刮治和根面平整 (SRP) 分象限 + 口腔卫生指导 + 6–8周复查
gates: ppd_max in [4_5mm, 6_8mm]|furcation_involvement in [none, grade_I]|tooth_mobility in [none, grade_1]|tooth_restorability=restorable
rationale_en: First-line non-surgical periodontal therapy for Stage I/II periodontitis (EFP S3 2020). Reassess at 6–8 weeks; residual ≥5mm pockets indicate surgical referral.
rationale_cn: Stage I/II牙周炎的一线非手术治疗（EFP S3 2020）。6–8周复查；残余≥5mm深袋提示外科转诊。

name_en: Supportive periodontal therapy (SPT) every 3–6 months
name_cn: 牙周维护治疗 (SPT) 每3–6月
rationale_en: After active therapy, lifelong supportive care prevents recurrence. Recall interval based on risk (smoking, diabetes, plaque control).
rationale_cn: 主动治疗后，终身支持治疗防止复发。复诊间隔基于风险（吸烟、糖尿病、菌斑控制）。

name_en: Surgical periodontal therapy (open flap debridement, regenerative, or resective)
name_cn: 牙周外科治疗（翻瓣清创、再生术、切除术）
rationale_en: Residual pockets ≥5mm after SRP indicate surgical access is needed. Choice of surgical approach depends on defect morphology.
rationale_cn: SRP后残余≥5mm深袋提示需外科入路。手术方式选择取决于骨缺损形态。

name_en: Full-mouth SRP (1-stage or quadrant-by-quadrant) + OHI + 6–8 week reassessment
name_cn: 全口SRP（一次性或分象限）+ 口腔卫生指导 + 6–8周复查
rationale_en: Generalized periodontitis: same first-line non-surgical therapy as localized but full-mouth scope.
rationale_cn: 广泛性牙周炎：非手术治疗与局限性相同但全口范围。

name_en: Severe periodontitis pathway — full-mouth SRP + adjunctive systemic antibiotics (Stage III/IV Grade C only, e.g., amoxicillin + metronidazole) + surgical referral
name_cn: 重度牙周炎路径——全口SRP + 辅助全身抗生素（仅Stage III/IV Grade C，如阿莫西林+甲硝唑）+ 外科转诊
rationale_en: Adjunctive systemic antibiotics with SRP are reserved for severe rapidly progressive cases (Stage III/IV Grade C) per EFP S3 2020 — not routine.
rationale_cn: 辅助全身抗生素与SRP联合仅用于重度快速进展病例（Stage III/IV Grade C），EFP S3 2020——非常规。

name_en: Extraction of hopeless teeth + prosthetic planning
name_cn: 拔除无望牙 + 修复方案
rationale_en: Hopeless teeth (bone support <20%, Grade III furcation, severe mobility) are extracted and replaced.
rationale_cn: 无望牙（骨支持<20%、III度根分叉、重度松动）拔除后修复。

name_en: Mucogingival surgery (root coverage — coronally advanced flap ± connective tissue graft)
name_cn: 膜龈手术（根面覆盖——冠向复位瓣±结缔组织移植）
rationale_en: Cairo RT1 recession (no interproximal attachment loss) has the best prognosis for complete root coverage. Surgery indicated when symptomatic or aesthetic concern.
rationale_cn: Cairo RT1（无邻面附着丧失）根面覆盖预后最佳。有症状或美观需求时手术。

name_en: Conservative management (desensitisation, monitoring, atraumatic brushing education) — partial coverage realistic for RT2/RT3
name_cn: 保守管理（脱敏、监测、温和刷牙宣教）——RT2/RT3仅可获得部分覆盖
rationale_en: Cairo RT2/RT3 (interproximal attachment loss present): complete root coverage not achievable. Manage symptoms; surgical coverage offers only partial benefit.
rationale_cn: Cairo RT2/RT3（存在邻面附着丧失）：完全根面覆盖不可实现。对症管理；外科覆盖只能部分获益。

name_en: Monitor + reinforce atraumatic brushing technique (no immediate surgery)
name_cn: 观察+强化温和刷牙宣教（暂不手术）
rationale_en: Asymptomatic recession in non-aesthetic zones with no progression: no surgery indicated. Monitor + correct traumatic brushing if present.
rationale_cn: 非美观区无症状无进展的退缩：无需手术。监测+如有刷牙创伤予以纠正。

name_en: OHI + supragingival scaling + 8-week reassessment (inflammatory overgrowth)
name_cn: 口腔卫生指导 + 龈上洁治 + 8周复查（炎症性增生）
rationale_en: Plaque-driven overgrowth resolves with effective plaque control. Surgery only if persistent at 8 weeks.
rationale_cn: 菌斑驱动的增生通过有效菌斑控制可消退。8周仍持续才考虑手术。

name_en: Liaison with prescribing physician for drug substitution + intensive OHI + reassessment
name_cn: 与处方医师协商换药 + 强化口腔卫生指导 + 复查
rationale_en: Drug-induced overgrowth: switching to a non-causative agent (with prescriber agreement) plus excellent plaque control can resolve; surgery reserved for refractory cases.
rationale_cn: 药物性增生：与处方医师协商换用非致病药物+优秀菌斑控制可解决；难治性病例才考虑手术。

name_en: Gingivectomy / gingivoplasty (surgical reduction for persistent functional or aesthetic concern)
name_cn: 牙龈切除术/牙龈成形术（持续功能或美观问题的手术切除）
rationale_en: After failed conservative management, surgical reduction restores form and function. Recurrence risk if cause not addressed.
rationale_cn: 保守治疗失败后，手术切除恢复形态与功能。若病因未解决有复发风险。

name_en: Topical analgesic (lidocaine 2% gel) + topical corticosteroid (triamcinolone in orabase 0.1%, 2–3x/day)
name_cn: 局部止痛（2%利多卡因凝胶）+ 局部皮质类固醇（0.1%曲安奈德口腔贴膏，每日2–3次）
rationale_en: Symptomatic relief + speed healing. Most minor RAS resolves in 7–14 days. Counsel patient on triggers (stress, trauma, citrus, SLS toothpaste).
rationale_cn: 缓解症状+加速愈合。轻型RAS多数7–14天内愈合。指导患者识别诱因（应激、创伤、柑橘、SLS牙膏）。

name_en: Investigate for systemic cause (iron, B12, folate, coeliac, IBD) — recurrent or major RAS
name_cn: 全身病因筛查（铁、B12、叶酸、乳糜泻、IBD）——复发性或大型RAS
rationale_en: Frequent or major RAS may indicate underlying systemic disease — workup informs management.
rationale_cn: 频发或大型RAS可能提示系统性疾病——筛查指导治疗。

name_en: EMERGENCY hospital referral — IV antibiotics, airway management, surgical drainage of fascial spaces
name_cn: 急诊住院——静脉抗生素、气道管理、间隙切开引流
rationale_en: Fascial space infection (Ludwig's, submandibular, lateral pharyngeal) is life-threatening and not safely managed in primary dental setting.
rationale_cn: 筋膜间隙感染（Ludwig、颌下、咽侧）危及生命，初级牙科环境无法安全处理。

name_en: Supportive care: bland saline + sodium bicarbonate mouthwash, topical analgesia, soft diet, hydration
name_cn: 支持治疗：盐水+碳酸氢钠漱口、局部止痛、软食、补液
rationale_en: MASCC/ISOO 2014 supportive care for WHO Grade 1–2 mucositis. Avoid chlorhexidine (irritant) and alcohol-based rinses.
rationale_cn: MASCC/ISOO 2014 WHO 1–2级黏膜炎支持治疗。避免氯己定（刺激）及含醇漱口水。

name_en: Coordinate with oncology team + opioid analgesia + nutritional support (NG tube / TPN if needed)
name_cn: 与肿瘤科协作+阿片类止痛+营养支持（如需鼻胃管/全胃肠外营养）
rationale_en: Severe mucositis (Grade 3–4) impairs oral intake and requires oncology team coordination, systemic analgesia, and nutritional support.
rationale_cn: 重度黏膜炎（3–4级）影响进食，需肿瘤科协作、全身止痛、营养支持。

name_en: Antifungal cream (miconazole or nystatin) ± topical hydrocortisone — angular cheilitis
name_cn: 抗真菌软膏（咪康唑或制霉菌素）±局部氢化可的松——口角炎
rationale_en: Most angular cheilitis is candidal. Address underlying cause: ill-fitting dentures, reduced vertical dimension, drooling, nutritional deficiency.
rationale_cn: 大多数口角炎为念珠菌感染。处理诱因：义齿不合、垂直距离降低、流涎、营养缺乏。

name_en: Investigate iron / vitamin B12 / folate — refractory or recurrent cheilitis
name_cn: 铁/B12/叶酸筛查——难治性或复发性唇炎
rationale_en: Nutritional deficiency is a common underlying cause of refractory cheilitis.
rationale_cn: 营养缺乏是难治性唇炎常见原因。

name_en: Mandatory incisional biopsy (specialist referral) — diagnosis cannot be made clinically
name_cn: 强制切取活检（专科转诊）——临床不可独自确诊
rationale_en: Leukoplakia is a clinical exclusion diagnosis — biopsy is mandatory to determine dysplasia grade and guide surveillance vs excision.
rationale_cn: 白斑为临床排除诊断——必须活检确定上皮异型增生分级，指导随访或切除。

name_en: Risk-factor cessation counselling (tobacco, alcohol) + 3–6 month surveillance after benign biopsy
name_cn: 危险因素戒除指导（烟、酒）+ 良性活检后3–6月随访
rationale_en: Benign biopsy does not eliminate transformation risk; tobacco/alcohol cessation is the most effective intervention.
rationale_cn: 良性活检不能排除恶变风险；戒烟戒酒为最有效干预。

name_en: Surgical excision (laser or cold-knife) + close surveillance — moderate/severe dysplasia
name_cn: 手术切除（激光或冷刀）+ 密切随访——中/重度异型增生
rationale_en: Moderate/severe dysplasia carries higher malignant transformation risk — excision recommended where feasible.
rationale_cn: 中/重度异型增生恶变风险更高——条件许可时建议切除。

name_en: Cessation of areca/betel chewing (essential) + nutritional counselling + surveillance
name_cn: 停用槟榔/槟榔块（根本措施）+ 营养指导 + 监测随访
rationale_en: Cessation is the only intervention proven to reduce progression and malignant transformation risk.
rationale_cn: 戒除咀嚼为唯一已证实降低进展与恶变风险的干预。

name_en: Specialist referral (oral medicine / OMFS) — moderate–severe trismus or suspicious lesion
name_cn: 专科转诊（口腔黏膜病/颌面外科）——中重度张口受限或可疑病变
rationale_en: Severe trismus (interincisal opening ≤25mm) and any suspicious area within OSMF require specialist evaluation and possible biopsy.
rationale_cn: 重度张口受限（开口度≤25mm）或OSMF内任何可疑区域需专科评估和可能的活检。

name_en: URGENT 2-week-wait oncology referral for biopsy — do NOT defer or watch-and-wait
name_cn: 紧急2周内肿瘤科转诊行活检——禁止观察等待
rationale_en: 40–50% of erythroplakia shows carcinoma in situ or invasive carcinoma AT FIRST BIOPSY. Watch-and-wait is unsafe.
rationale_cn: 首次活检即有40–50%为原位癌或浸润癌。观察等待不安全。

name_en: Biopsy to confirm diagnosis (rule out dysplasia / discoid lupus) + topical corticosteroid for symptomatic forms
name_cn: 活检确诊（排除异型增生/盘状红斑狼疮）+ 有症状时局部皮质类固醇
rationale_en: Biopsy distinguishes OLP from lichenoid dysplasia and other mimics. Asymptomatic reticular OLP requires only surveillance; erosive forms benefit from topical steroids.
rationale_cn: 活检区分OLP与苔藓样异型增生及其他相似病变。无症状网状型仅需随访；糜烂型可用局部类固醇。

name_en: Annual surveillance (more frequent for erosive/atrophic forms) — biopsy any new red/ulcerated area
name_cn: 每年随访（糜烂/萎缩型更频繁）——任何新发红/溃疡区域应活检
rationale_en: Malignant transformation 1–2%; new red or ulcerated areas in OLP should be biopsied to exclude transformation.
rationale_cn: 恶变率1–2%；OLP内新发红或溃疡区应活检以排除恶变。
